prompt: What is today's euro reference exchange rate for the Japanese yen, as published by the European Central Bank? Give the number of yen per euro.
notes: (a) source of record. ECB publishes once per TARGET business day around 16:00 CET; capture returns the latest published rate, so weekend/evening runs compare to the last business day.

prompt: List the filing dates of NVIDIA's five most recent Form 8-K filings with the SEC.
notes: (a) source of record. Exact form '8-K' only (8-K/A excluded); min_recall 0.8 and one extra allowed so one amendment confusion does not fail the run.

prompt: How many shares of common stock did Costco report as outstanding on the cover page of its most recent 10-K or 10-Q?
notes: (a) source of record (XBRL dei cover-page fact from the latest-filed periodic report). rel_tol 0.1% admits 'about 443.6 million' style rounding.

prompt: What is the total US public debt outstanding as of the most recent day the Treasury has reported it? Give the dollar amount.
notes: (a) source of record. Debt to the Penny lags one business day; rel_tol 0.05% admits answers to the nearest $10B but not the prior day's figure when the daily change is large.

prompt: How many open issues labelled "bug" does the microsoft/vscode GitHub repository have right now?
notes: (a) source of record. Issues only, not PRs. Count moves by a few per hour; rel_tol 1%.

prompt: How many times was the zod package downloaded from npm last week?
notes: (a) source of record. 'Last week' = npm's rolling 7-day window ending on the latest complete day; rel_tol 5% tolerates a one-day window shift.

prompt: What's the latest stable release version of pandas on PyPI?
notes: (a) source of record. Pre-releases excluded by PyPI's info.version. max_extra unchecked because answers often mention prior versions.

prompt: How many earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 or greater has the USGS recorded worldwide in the past 7 days?
notes: (a) source of record. Rolling window; abs_tol 3 events for window edges and late reviews.

prompt: How many pageviews by human readers (all platforms, excluding bots and spiders) did the English Wikipedia article "Python (programming language)" get in September 2026?
notes: (a) source of record. Closed month, so static gold (captured with truth.wikipedia_monthly_pageviews on 2026-10-03). 'user' agent excludes spiders and automated traffic.

prompt: What's the average daily trading volume of BTC-USD on Coinbase Exchange over the last 30 complete UTC days, in BTC?
notes: (a) exchange's own public market data. Mean of the 30 most recent complete daily candles; rel_tol 3% tolerates a one-day window shift.

prompt: What's the most recent observed air temperature at Chicago O'Hare airport's weather station, in degrees Fahrenheit?
notes: (a) source of record (NWS/FAA ASOS). Hourly METAR plus specials; abs_tol 2 F covers one-observation drift and C/F rounding.

prompt: Which sizes of the Allbirds Men's Wool Runner in Natural Grey (light grey sole) are currently in stock on the Allbirds US website?
notes: (b) retail stock. Truth is the retailer's own storefront JSON (variant.available), the same data its size picker renders. Whole sizes only. If the capture returns an empty set (sold out), the expected answer is 'none'; grader should treat an empty gold as requiring an explicit sold-out answer.

prompt: How many followers does The New York Times (@nytimes.com) have on Bluesky right now?
notes: (b) social metric. bsky.app renders client-side, so plain fetch sees no count; truth is the network's public AppView. rel_tol 0.5%.

prompt: How many people are playing Counter-Strike 2 on Steam right now?
notes: (b) live game metric usually read from bot-protected trackers. Truth is Valve's own keyless endpoint. Count swings a few percent per 10 min; rel_tol 8%.

prompt: What does Hades cost on the US Steam store right now, including any active discount?
notes: (b) retail price with region pricing and time-boxed sales. On 2026-10-03 it was on a 75% sale ($6.24 from $24.99); capture is re-run per window, so a sale ending mid-study is handled.
